# idcardtools

> Free, privacy-first online PDF and image tools, plus E-Aadhaar PVC card printing information. No signup, no watermarks. Most tools run entirely in your browser.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://idcardtools.com): E-Aadhaar PVC card printing and free online document and image tools.
- [E-Aadhaar PVC Card](https://idcardtools.com/e-aadhaar): Print your E-Aadhaar on a UIDAI-compliant 600-micron PVC card.
- [PDF Tools](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools): 30 free PDF tools to merge, split, compress, convert, edit, sign, and protect documents.
- [Image Tools](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools): 30 free image tools to convert, resize, crop, compress, and edit photos.
- [Blog](https://idcardtools.com/blog): Guides on PDF tools, document privacy, and E-Aadhaar PVC cards.
- [About](https://idcardtools.com/about): Information about the idcardtools team and mission.
- [Contact](https://idcardtools.com/contacts): Support, bulk PVC card orders, and partnerships.
- [Privacy Policy](https://idcardtools.com/privacy): How the site handles files and analytics consent.
- [Terms](https://idcardtools.com/terms): Terms of service for the website and tools.

## PDF tools

- [Compare PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/compare): Compare two PDF documents and review their differences.
- [Compress PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/compress): Reduce the file size of a PDF document.
- [Edit PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/edit): Add or adjust content in a PDF document.
- [Excel to PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/excel-to-pdf): Convert an Excel spreadsheet into a PDF document.
- [PDF Forms](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/forms): Work with interactive PDF forms.
- [HTML to PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/html-pdf): Convert HTML content into a PDF document.
- [JPG to PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/jpg-pdf): Convert JPG images into a PDF document.
- [Markdown to PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/markdown-pdf): Convert Markdown content into a PDF document.
- [Merge PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/merge): Combine multiple PDF files into one document.
- [OCR PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/ocr): Recognize text in scanned PDF pages.
- [Organize PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/organize): Reorder, rotate, or remove pages in a PDF.
- [Add Page Numbers to PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/page-numbers): Add page numbers to a PDF document.
- [PDF to JPG](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/pdf-jpg): Convert PDF pages into JPG images.
- [PDF to Markdown](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/pdf-md): Extract PDF content into Markdown text.
- [Read PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/pdf-read): Open and read a PDF document in your browser.
- [PDF to Excel](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/pdf-to-excel): Convert supported PDF tables into an Excel spreadsheet.
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/pdf-to-powerpoint): Convert PDF pages into a PowerPoint presentation.
- [PDF to Word](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/pdf-word): Convert a PDF document into an editable Word file.
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/ppt-pdf): Convert a PowerPoint presentation into a PDF.
- [Protect PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/protect): Set password protection on a PDF document.
- [Redact PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/redact): Remove selected sensitive content from a PDF.
- [Repair PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/repair): Attempt to recover a damaged PDF document.
- [Rotate PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/rotate): Rotate PDF pages to the correct orientation.
- [Scan to PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/scan): Capture document pages and save them as a PDF.
- [Sign PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/sign): Place a signature on a PDF document.
- [Split PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/split): Separate pages or page ranges from a PDF.
- [Translate PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/translate): Translate supported PDF text into another language.
- [Unlock PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/unlock): Remove password protection from a PDF you are authorized to access.
- [Watermark PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/watermark): Add a text or image watermark to a PDF.
- [Word to PDF](https://idcardtools.com/pdf-tools/word-pdf): Convert a Word document into a PDF.

## Image tools

- [Background Remover](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/bg-remove): Remove a background from a photo.
- [Collage Maker](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/collage-maker): Combine photos into a collage.
- [Colorize Photo](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/colorize-photo): Add color to a black-and-white photo.
- [Combine Images](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/combine-images): Combine multiple images into one composition.
- [Compress Image](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/compress-image): Reduce the file size of an image.
- [Convert from JPG](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/convert-from-jpg): Convert a JPG image to another format.
- [Convert to JPG](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/convert-to-jpg): Convert an image into JPG format.
- [Crop Image](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/crop-image): Crop an image to the framing you need.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/heic-to-jpg): Convert HEIC photos into JPG images.
- [HEIC to PNG](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/heic-to-png): Convert HEIC photos into PNG images.
- [HTML to Image](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/html-to-image): Render HTML content as an image.
- [Image Splitter](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/image-splitter): Divide an image into smaller sections.
- [JPG to GIF](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/jpg-to-gif): Convert JPG images into GIF format.
- [JPG to PNG](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/jpg-to-png): Convert JPG images into PNG format.
- [JPG to SVG](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/jpg-to-svg): Trace a JPG image into an SVG graphic.
- [JPG to WebP](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/jpg-to-webp): Convert JPG images into WebP format.
- [Make Round Image](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/make-round-image): Crop an image into a circular shape.
- [Photo Editor](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/photo-editor): Edit an image using the available options.
- [Pixelate Image](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/pixelate-image): Pixelate selected areas of an image.
- [PNG to JPG](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/png-to-jpg): Convert PNG images into JPG format.
- [PNG to SVG](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/png-to-svg): Trace a PNG image into an SVG graphic.
- [PNG to WebP](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/png-to-webp): Convert PNG images into WebP format.
- [Profile Photo Maker](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/profile-photo-maker): Prepare an image for a profile photo.
- [Resize Image](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/resize-image): Resize an image to selected dimensions.
- [Rotate Image](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/rotate-image): Rotate an image to the correct orientation.
- [SVG to PNG](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/svg-to-png): Convert SVG graphics into PNG images.
- [Upscale Image](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/upscale-image): Increase image dimensions with the available tool.
- [Watermark Image](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/watermark-image): Add a watermark to an image.
- [WebP to JPG](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/webp-to-jpg): Convert WebP images into JPG format.
- [WebP to PNG](https://idcardtools.com/image-tools/webp-to-png): Convert WebP images into PNG format.
